widgets.widgetName: Name(s) as shown on return
Your S S N or I T I N (9 digits)

Part I, Line 1. 2025 tax after credits from Form 540, line 48, line 61, line 62, and any I R C Section 453A interest from line 63; Form 540NR, line 63, line 71, line 72, and any I R C Section 453A interest from line 73; or Form 541, line 28
Line 10. Enter the smaller of line 4 or line 9. (If your California A G I is equal to or greater than $1,000,000/$500,000 for married filing a separate return, use line 4.)

Line 11. 2025 withholding taxes and estimated tax payments made on or before January 15, 2026, from Form 540, line 71, line 72, and line 73; Form 540NR, line 81, line 82, and line 83; or Form 541, line 29, line 31, and line 32
Line 12. Underpayment. Subtract line 11 from line 10. If zero or less, you do not owe a penalty. Be sure to check the box on Form 540, line 113; Form 540NR, line 123; or Form 541, line 45
Part II, Line 13. Enter the date (mm/dd/yyyy) the amount on line 12 was paid or April 15, 2026, whichever is earlier
Line 14. Number of days after January 15, 2026, to and including the date on line 13

Line 15. Penalty: Number of days on line 14 divided by 365 multiplied by 0.7 multiplied by underpayment on line 12. Enter the result here. If you are requesting a waiver, go to line 16. Otherwise, enter this amount on Form 540, line 113; Form 540NR, line 123; or Form 541, line 45. Also, check the box on that line to show that form F T B 5805F is attached to the return

Line 16. To request a waiver, check the box on this line and provide an explanation below. Be sure to check the box on Form 540, line 113; Form 540NR, line 123; or Form 541, line 45. See General Information E
Enter explanation for waiver (1):
Enter explanation for waiver (2):
Line 16 - To request a waiver, check the box on this line
Line 2. 2025 tax on lump-sum distributions and accumulation distribution of trusts from Form 540, line 34; Form 540NR, line 41; or Form 541, line 21b
Line 3. Subtract line 2 from line 1
Line 4. Multiply line 3 by 66 and two-thirds % (.6667)
Line 5. 2025 withholding taxes from Form 540, line 71 and line 73; Form 540NR, line 81 and line 83; or Form 541, line 29 and line 31
Line 6. Subtract line 5 from line 3. If less than $500 ($250 if married/R D P filing separately), STOP. You do not owe a penalty

Line 7. 2024 tax after credits from Form 540, line 48, line 61, line 62, and any I R C Section 453A interest from line 63; Form 540NR, line 63, line 71, line 72, and any I R C Section 453A interest from line 73; or Form 541, line 28. (If you did not file a return for 2024 or if your 2024 taxable year was less than 12 months, do not complete line 7 through line 9. Instead, enter the amount from line 4 on line 10.)
Line 8. 2024 tax on lump-sum distributions and accumulation distribution of trusts from Form 540, line 34; Form 540NR, line 41; or Form 541, line 21b
Line 9. Subtract line 8 from line 7. If less than $500 ($250 if married/R D P filing separately), STOP. You do not owe a penalty
